chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Layth al-Muradi, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who comes to Mecca during the days of Mina after finishing his visit to the House, and performs tawaf around the House as a voluntary act. He said: Staying in Mina is better and more beloved to me.

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a plain near Mecca where pilgrims stay during Hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it better to stay in Mina or perform voluntary tawaf during the days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Istibsar, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that while voluntary tawaf is praiseworthy, the spiritual merit of remaining in Mina for contemplation and adherence to the Sunnah of the days of Tashriq outweighs it. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the specific virtues of the Hajj days, prioritizing the state of presence and devotion in Mina over additional ritual acts outside its precincts. It serves as a practical guide for pilgrims to maximize their reward by valuing the prescribed duration of stay in Mina.
